findings.title: On the sample tenant most Build new types cannot plan: it carries no network applications, DNS gateways, cloud application catalogue, Cloud App Control rule types, ZPA provisioning keys or inspection controls, and its in-memory store does not model ZPA policy rule writes or Client Connector's edit endpoints; each builder says plainly what it could not read and writes nothing
findings.fix: open: widening the sample tenant to every builder's catalogues (and its write model) changes what the sample shows on every page, a product decision; the builders fail closed with the reason meanwhile

findings.title: Review & remediate 'Add Description to a Rule' sent PATCH, which the raw client turns into a PUT carrying only the description: ZIA's PUT replaces the rule, so the rule's name, action, conditions and engines were wiped (or the write refused); its firewall option named a path that does not exist (firewallRules)
findings.fix: the recipe is a read-modify-write PUT (merge): the rule is read and sent back whole with only its description changed; the option is firewallFilteringRules

findings.title: Plain HTTP (TCP/80, http://) was reported as 'encrypted, DLP blind' with no SSL rule, and as 'decrypted' with one
findings.fix: The trace takes plain HTTP as having no TLS: SSL hop not applicable, content visible, headline says unencrypted (plain HTTP)

findings.title: A Cloud Firewall rule naming only IPv6 destination groups matched every destination (a definite wrong block of IPv4 traffic)
findings.fix: destIpv6Groups and srcIpv6Groups are criteria: never an IPv4 address, unknown for IPv6 (their list is not read)

findings.title: URL filtering, File Type Control and Web DLP rule protocols were ignored by the trace: an HTTP-only block rule was said to block HTTPS
findings.fix: The trace applies each rule's protocols (one shared helper with the module criteria)

findings.title: Web DLP excluded users, groups and departments were ignored: definite 'enforce' for excluded users, and the what-if for an excluded group still enforced
findings.fix: Exclusions are scope (conditional for any user) and a negated what-if dimension

findings.title: A single-object re-read (admin_ops._one, the read before every Build new and Bulk changes update and the read-back) dropped fields SDK 1.11.3's model leaves out: a ZIA baseline re-run that updated a sandbox rule sent it back without its isolation profile (PUT replaces the rule), and every first build with an isolation profile was reported 'partial' with a false read-back mismatch
findings.fix: pack_export.one_row fills what the model omits from the raw answer, as the list reader already did; admin_ops._one uses it

findings.title: Applying a proposal (and self-healing's Heal) to an Email DLP rule sent the rule back without zscalerIncidentReceiver and rank (not in the SDK model) and with the model's padding inside the engine references: incident forwarding was silently turned off while the change read back as verified
findings.fix: proposal_apply reads rules through pack_export._rows (raw fields and references kept) before writing them back whole

findings.title: Bulk changes: moving a segment's only domain was previewed as a move but, at apply time, the removal was excluded (ZPA keeps one domain per segment) after the addition was written, so the move became a copy reported 'partial'; a clone-and-move created a new segment with no domain at all
findings.fix: the plan excludes a removal that would empty a segment with that reason, excludes its paired addition and every step that waits for an excluded one; the clone handler never creates an empty segment

findings.title: Undo of a pack deployment deleted what it created but left the confidence a tweak had changed on an existing tenant dictionary, and still reported 'undone' and complete
findings.fix: the deploy records each tweak's before and after; Undo puts the confidence back while the dictionary still holds the tweaked value (else skips and says why), then activates

findings.title: A network service UDP_ANY or ICMP_ANY on a rule was 'unknown' for TCP traffic, making the firewall answer falsely conditional
findings.fix: A protocol-wide service of another protocol is a definite no match

findings.title: A URL or DLP rule limited to a user risk score was treated as applying to everyone: a definite 'Blocked' headline under a conditional certainty
findings.fix: userRiskScoreLevels is scope in the trace and an open what-if dimension

findings.title: A URL filtering rule's validity period (enforceTimeValidity) was ignored: a block outside its period was reported as definite
findings.fix: An enforced validity period is a condition named with its dates

findings.title: A scoped SSL or URL rule with the same action ahead of the deciding rule made the answer conditional
findings.fix: Only a scoped rule that would act differently makes the answer conditional

findings.title: A bare custom URL category entry (example.com) placed its subdomains in the category, and a path entry placed every path
findings.fix: Category placement uses ZIA's URL list semantics (zia_path_modules.url_hit), path entries only for that path

findings.title: Internationalised host names (IDN) were refused by the Path analyzer, Test a list and ZPA diagnostics
findings.fix: IDN hosts are converted to punycode (UTS 46) as ZIA, ZPA and DNS hold them

findings.title: A password typed in a URL (https://user:pass@host/) was repeated in the result and in error messages
findings.fix: User info is left out of the echoed input and every message

findings.title: The PAC file was evaluated against the full https:// URL (browsers strip it to scheme, host and port) and against https:// for plain-HTTP traffic
findings.fix: path_analyzer.pac_url gives the URL a browser passes; Test a list uses the same one

findings.title: A conditional SSL rule after a definite firewall, ATP or DNS block still made the answer conditional; non-web or bypassed traffic stayed 'policy conditional' on web rules it never meets
findings.fix: SSL is not reached after a definite stop; policy_conditional is recomputed from the hops as they stand

findings.title: ZPA diagnostics said 'Depends on the user' when every possible answer is deny, and 'unless' an earlier rule with the same action
findings.fix: Only an earlier rule that would allow where the rest deny (or the reverse) makes it conditional

findings.title: Test a list shared one answer between rows that must differ: list entries with a trailing dot, an IPv4 and an IPv6 row, PAC answers for http:// rows
findings.fix: The sharing fingerprint strips trailing dots, includes the address family and evaluates the PAC for the row's own URL

findings.title: Log analyzer: a PAC the new evaluator refuses (regular expression, array, loop, switch) lost its whole reading (default, gateways, bypass inventory, fail-open/closed, hard-coded gateway), including a reference-style PAC
findings.fix: log_analyzer reads such a PAC from its text again (never run, bounded to pac_eval.MAX_SOURCE) and still says it was not evaluated

findings.title: The API access page (reachable without the UI token) showed the latest readiness answers: tenant name, API role, licences and what works
findings.fix: /permissions renders the live part only for a caller who passes security.ui_request_ok, no-store when it does

findings.title: A saved or opened snapshot kept the values of policyToken, deviceToken, machineToken, authenticationToken and provisioningKey fields
findings.fix: offline_tenant.scrub masks text values under token and key names (true/false switches stay)

findings.title: An API error page that repeats the Authorization header put the OneAPI access token into Path analyzer and Test a list job logs, results and exports, POV evidence and the install command builder's answer
findings.fix: The raw client masks every error text it returns (secrets and its own token); tenant_auth.mask_secrets and SDK error texts redact bearer tokens, JWTs and session ids by shape

findings.title: A PAC hex literal past 2^1024 raised OverflowError out of pac_eval.evaluate() and inspect() (tenant PAC read, log upload, Test a list); other parse errors were not failed closed
findings.fix: hex literals read as Infinity like JavaScript; compile_pac turns any unexpected parse error into 'could not evaluate safely'

findings.title: An imported POV file with NaN was stored and made the import and every later open of that profile's POV a 500
findings.fix: POV import reads strict JSON; Insights counts kept only when finite

findings.title: ZIA framework files were not type-checked: fields of the wrong type made the Bulk changes preview a 500, non-string names were coerced, and names with right-to-left overrides or zero-width characters were written to the tenant as rule names
findings.fix: load_framework denies by default: name and title text, fields an object, format_version an integer, no bidirectional / invisible / control character in a name

findings.title: A framework rule title (or a captured rule description) was cut one character at a time with a re-encode each step: quadratic, minutes of CPU for a 1 MB title
findings.fix: _fit_bytes cuts to the byte limit in characters first, then trims

findings.title: Undo applied any operation under undo_of: it marked the recorded operation undone without applying its inverse, and an already undone operation was signed in to again
findings.fix: _ops_apply_gate requires the recorded inverse exactly and refuses an operation already undone (409) before sign-in

findings.title: Undo-only forms (url_categories / zpa_domains / zia_baseline revert, AI Guard undo, ZPA undo) were accepted as ordinary operations, so an apply could delete objects the app never created (a customer's ZPA segment was deleted)
findings.fix: admin_ops.is_undo_only: such a form is applied only with undo_of naming its recorded operation (409 otherwise, before sign-in)

findings.title: Two applies of the same plan at once both passed the plan hash and the re-read and both sent the create
findings.fix: pack_ops.tenant_run: one write run per tenant (deploy, removal, undo, bulk change, build); a second is refused busy with nothing read or written, audited, and a queued request stays approved

findings.title: The shared write path re-sent a create answered by a timeout or 5xx, which may have been applied, for every object kind (duplicates)
findings.fix: pack_ops.call resends a maybe-applied create only after a read by name shows it absent (name_check for pack kinds), else reports it not resent; a found object is reused

findings.title: The raw HTTP client (remediation, migration wizard) re-sent a POST after a read timeout, a reset connection or a 502/504
findings.fix: Client._write does not resend such a POST and says so; connection never made, 429/503 and idempotent PUT/DELETE retry as before

findings.title: The migration wizard's live delete-all and post had no plan hash: delete-all deleted rules added after its dry run, post overwrote rules edited since
findings.fix: dry runs return a plan hash over the tenant's rules (and the proposal); live runs require it (400 before sign-in) and give plan_changed when the tenant moved; the page sends it

findings.title: Remediation recipes offered values ZIA does not take and could crash: the Web DLP rule defaulted to ALERT and offered ISOLATE (not Web DLP actions), the URL rule had no protocols (required by the SDK's add_rule) and offered ISOLATE without an isolation profile, and leaving out an optional number (rank) raised TypeError (HTTP 500) instead of using its default
findings.fix: Web DLP actions ALLOW (default, monitor), BLOCK, CONFIRM; URL rules send protocols ANY_RULE and drop ISOLATE; optional fields take their default before rendering

findings.title: Readiness said 'Will work' for the ZPA builder, ZPA segment moves and the Client Connector builder when that product was not in scope and nothing was checked (even with a read-only role in the token)
findings.fix: a write feature of a product not in scope is 'Not in scope' with the step to tick it

findings.title: Readiness said 'Not checked' for the ZPA builders when the ZPA customer ID was empty, while the ZPA scope itself said 'Will not work'
findings.fix: the ZPA write features are blocked with the customer-ID steps, as the scope is

findings.title: Snapshot compare hid a change: ZIA and ZDX lists with the same name (Locations, departments) and the same counts were taken for one list served twice, so the second was dropped from the rows and the totals
findings.fix: ZDX lists are named as ZDX's; only rows with the same name and the same objects count once

findings.title: POV Prove it recorded 'the configuration agrees with the expected result' for 'Business sites keep working' (and the chat or view tests of the cloud-app runbook) when the Path analyzer found the site blocked
findings.fix: a 'reachable' expectation for the tests whose site must keep working: decrypted and neither blocked nor bypassed

findings.title: The sample tenant answered with field names and shapes the API does not use (ATP phishingSiteBlocked, an SSL rule's decryptSubActions.minTLSVersion, Web DLP URL categories as plain strings), so pages run on the sample read 'known phishing not blocked' and no TLS minimum
findings.fix: knownPhishingSitesBlocked, minClientTLSVersion and minServerTLSVersion, URL category references, checked against the SDK models

findings.title: A bare IPv6 address was refused, and an IPv6 destination became its own URL category and application
findings.fix: Bare IPv6 accepted; an IP literal is resolved as a host, never as a category; IPv4-mapped addresses checked as IPv4

findings.title: Conditional answers said only 'the decision depends on conditions that are not established'
findings.fix: Each reason names the rule, its action and the condition (group, time window, risk score, validity, request method)

findings.title: Data Flow Map tile 'reach ZIA, left encrypted' counted paths the gap list calls unverified; the tiles did not add up to the paths traced
findings.fix: One visibility class per path (data_flow.visibility, the page's own order); blocked, unverified and decrypted-without-DLP tiles added

findings.title: SSL coverage accepted a non-finite protocol volume, giving NaN percentages and JSON that does not parse
findings.fix: A NaN, infinite or negative volume is not counted

findings.title: Port 0 was accepted and silently traced as port 80 or 443
findings.fix: Port 0 is refused in words

findings.title: Test a list traced a row with protocol 'http' as HTTPS (TCP/443)
findings.fix: Protocol http is TCP/80 and https TCP/443 unless a port is given

findings.title: A conditional ZPA answer said 'Depends on who the user is or on facts not given' without naming the rule or the fact
findings.fix: The headline names each earlier rule and the fact it needs, or the VPN On-Net question

findings.title: Log analyzer: a DIRECT condition written in a PAC helper function (isCorp(host)) was no longer listed as a bypass
findings.fix: pac_eval.inspect expands a helper's returned conditions once per condition (static, never run; recursion cannot loop)

findings.title: Tenant profiles: a store whose snapshots entry is not an object made the profile list and profile delete fail with 500 (the pre-Wave-5 code ignored the key)
findings.fix: tenant_profiles._read treats a non-object snapshots entry as empty

findings.title: The access token decode raised OverflowError on an exp or iat integer too large for a float
findings.fix: readiness._iso bounds the number before any arithmetic

findings.title: The standalone edition started with writes on from ENABLE_WRITE_ACTIONS (environment or a local_settings.env any program of the user can write) and took a fixed, never-rotated ZSCALER_UI_TOKEN
findings.fix: standalone_main.configure ignores both with a notice; the smoke test starts the build with both set

findings.title: A typed client secret pasted into another field of a request (a POV's customer or notes) was written to the audit log in clear
findings.fix: audit.redact masks the request's own secret values wherever they appear in it

findings.title: The job runner's log and error and the crash log (server.log and the debug answer) kept an exception's text unmasked
findings.fix: pack_jobs and the exception handler pass the text through tenant_auth.redact_tokens

findings.title: The sample/snapshot cookie lacked Secure behind a TLS reverse proxy (X-Forwarded-Proto), unlike the UI token cookie
findings.fix: The cookie uses security._https like the UI token cookie

findings.title: PAC parse was quadratic: every call rescanned the source for its line number (1.7 s for 145 KB, outside the 0.5 s evaluation cap)
findings.fix: line numbers by binary search over newline offsets found once

findings.title: An opened snapshot with NaN / Infinity made every job poll on it a 500 (invalid JSON in the result)
findings.fix: parse_snapshot reads strict RFC 8259 JSON (safe_files.strict_json_loads)

findings.title: A policy pack upload with NaN passed validation (rule rank NaN) and was kept; its bundle download was not JSON
findings.fix: pack uploads read strict JSON

findings.title: HAR batch host entries with a non-list methods/schemes or a NaN / Infinity count answered 500
findings.fix: counts accepted only as finite numbers and lists only as lists

findings.title: The live feed trusted the tally the browser echoes back: unknown keys or wrong types answered 500 (KeyError / TypeError)
findings.fix: live_stats rebuilds the tally from its known counters, whole numbers only

findings.title: Test a list read every file as UTF-8: a UTF-16 list (Excel Unicode Text) lost its header, so its expected column and every non-ASCII letter
findings.fix: the page decodes by byte order mark (UTF-16 LE/BE, else UTF-8)

findings.title: A right-to-left override in a tenant name reordered the text after it in Markdown, CSV, Excel and Word exports, and sat raw in generated Terraform source (Trojan Source style)
findings.fix: export cleaners show explicit bidirectional controls as U+FFFD; Terraform strings escape invisible characters as \uNNNN (read back unchanged by the pack reader)

findings.title: Typed confirmations accepted Unicode look-alikes that str.upper() folds into the phrase (dotless i, long s) in the change queue apply, heal, stricter proposal approval and bulk-change phrases
findings.fix: security.typed_phrase_matches: case-insensitive per character, NFC only, deliberately no NFKC, blank never matches; used at all four sites

findings.title: A provisioning key created through the synchronous apply route was stashed with no owner, so another writer holding the token could reveal it
findings.fix: ops_zpa._actor takes the run's actor from the audit scope (sync route) as well as the job

findings.title: Remediation recipes pre-selected rule state ENABLED (a BLOCK_DROP firewall rule, a DECRYPT SSL rule, a BLOCK URL rule at order 1)
findings.fix: every recipe's state defaults to DISABLED; a missing state stays refused as required

findings.title: AI Guard routing (ENABLED ZIA rules: SSL Inspect at the top, Allow above Block, forwarding) and a blocking detection policy applied without the typed phrase below ten changes, unlike the ZIA baseline
findings.fix: ops_aiguard asks its phrase every time a plan turns enforcement on; monitor-only keeps the count rule

findings.title: The pack deploy confidence tweak PUT the whole dictionary from the plan's snapshot, overwriting a change made while the run was writing
findings.fix: the dictionary is re-read right before the PUT; changed, gone or unreadable is skipped with the reason

findings.title: A proposal rollback overwrote a value someone set after the apply; the apply's re-read before writing was not compared with the preview
findings.fix: rollback only while the rule holds the value the apply set; every write compares its re-read with the previewed value

findings.title: Known flaky test_tenant_pacing: the 429-hold test asserted 19 s left of a 20 s hold on the wall clock, so a 1 s scheduling stall under load failed it (reproduced by injecting a 1.2 s stall)
findings.fix: the test freezes ZIA's rate clock at the moment the hold is published and asserts the exact 20 s

findings.title: A blank confirm_phrase from a plugin hid its confirm_always phrase, switching the typed confirmation off
findings.fix: admin_ops._finish takes the first non-blank of the two
